text: Blot Immobilier (SIREN 385038724) is a SAS registered in Rennes. The company register lists David Blot as its président, Sandra Blot as vice-président, and Jean Blot, Marie-France Blot (Poirier) and Didier Ferre as members of its conseil de surveillance. Blot's own site dates the business to 1968.
short: Blot Immobilier is led by members of the Blot family (company register).

source.note: Same response: BLOT Sandra (Vice-Président); BLOT Jean, BLOT (POIRIER) Marie-France and FERRE Didier (Membre du conseil de surveillance); nature juridique 5710 (SAS), siège Rennes (35238).
